title: Breaking the Fixed-Substrate Limitation of Deep Learning Ellipsometry with Pseudo-Substrate Spectra
summary: FiLM-DLE takes both a thin-film spectrum and a pre-deposition pseudo-substrate spectrum as inputs. On 47 measured films across diverse substrates, its optical-constant and thickness estimates had mean absolute errors of 0.047, 0.030 and 1.52 nm, respectively, against manual analysis; each analysis took under two seconds.
ai_technology: Two-input deep-learning ellipsometry using pseudo-substrate spectra
organization: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology; Nagaoka University of Technology
